audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers rendered Aurora / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Aurora, which matches neither the packet chart nor the why-lines printed under each row.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Volibear / Volibear / Aurora / Volibear, and whys[1], whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] already describe exactly that pattern.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to the packet chart, with ratings rebuilt. Level 6 is set to Volibear per the packet and whys[4] rewritten to agree — the Stormbringer tower disable is the real spike there.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Aurora cooldown appeared anywhere, and Volibear's R was repeatedly credited with sustain and attack speed.
audit.why: Stormbringer grants bonus Health, a slow and a tower disable — no heal, no attack speed. That is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Twofold Hex 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 900 range, Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18s, Between Worlds 140/120/100s and Stormbringer 160/135/110s written into early, mid, late, spikes and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked ability was labelled 'Twofold Hex (Blink)', Aurora's passive was called true damage, her W was given a double charge, and her R was described as walls.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is the Q missile-plus-recast; the blink is Across the Veil (W), a single leap into invisibility. Spirit Abjuration exorcises spirits that follow and HEAL her — no true damage in Riot's text, and no W charges. Between Worlds creates a slowing area she can teleport across, not a wall.
audit.corrected: focus.text and dosFull[0].t renamed to Across the Veil; spikes[0-3], early, mid, late, whys[2] and the wants[] lines rewritten to the real behaviour, including that Thundering Smash's stun rides the first attack so you must close before you swing.

edits.before: Aurora pokes with Q bounce and W-blinks out of your reach; her passive true damage stacks on you, so don't chase her through minions early.
edits.after: Twofold Hex (9s) curses you on the way out and damages again on the recast, and Spirit Abjuration heals her off it — don't feed her free procs.

edits.before: Her R zones and can wall you off, but your R's attack speed lets you stick — Q-flip her the instant she W-blinks and burst before she resets.
edits.after: Between Worlds (140s) makes a slow zone she can teleport across — it is not a wall. Stormbringer's tower disable is still the better level-6 button.

edits.before: Her mana and AP spike restores her kite; her W double-charge lets her dodge your Q flip twice, so respect her burst until your bruiser item.
edits.after: Her first AP item restores the kite. Across the Veil (22s at rank 1) is her only blink — once it is spent she has The Weirding's hop and nothing else.

edits.before: You out-scale as a diver: your R sustain shrugs off her poke and one Q-flip through her W ends her squishy frame, so hold your ult for her engage.
edits.after: You outscale as a diver: Stormbringer's bonus health shrugs off her poke and one Thundering Smash stun ends her, so hold it for after Between Worlds.

edits.before: Level 1 is even, but from 2-3 Aurora's Q bounce poke and W blinks let her whittle you while staying out of Q range. Her passive true-damage procs add up, so don't chase her through the wave — farm and stack your passive.
edits.after: Level 1 is even, but from 2-3 Twofold Hex (900 range, 9s) pokes from outside your 300-range stun, and every hit feeds Spirit Abjuration's heal. Don't chase her through the wave — farm and stack The Relentless Storm.

edits.before: Level 4-5 is your window: once your basics online you can force her W-blink and Q-flip her the moment it's down, W-proccing her low HP frame. All-in while her escape is on cooldown.
edits.after: Level 4-5 is your window: bait Across the Veil (22s at rank 1), then charge Thundering Smash — the stun rides your first attack, so close in before you swing. Frenzied Maul twice for the heal.

edits.before: She reclaims poke tempo at first item with her mana and double W-charge, but you out-scale. Your R sustain eats her poke and one clean flip through her blink ends her. Hold your ult for her R engage and turn it.
edits.after: She reclaims poke tempo at first item, but you outscale. Stormbringer's bonus health eats her poke and one Thundering Smash ends her once Across the Veil is spent. Hold your ult for her Between Worlds and turn it.

notes: The packet chart and whys[4] disagreed about Level 6 (packet Volibear, prose Aurora). I followed the packet and rewrote whys[4], since Stormbringer's tower disable is a concrete level-6 spike and Between Worlds is a 140s zoning ult, not a duel-winner — flagged in questionsForUser in case the intended reading was Aurora. 'Twofold Hex (Blink)' is the tracked-ability label and it recurs in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, ahead, breakdown.* and most report[] entries; I fixed focus.text and dosFull[0].t, but the remaining ~20 occurrences want a scripted rename to Across the Veil.
